# **WRITEUP IFEST13**

## WEB - PixelPlaza2

Flag: IFEST13{g0L4nG\_5UpP0rt5\_p4th\_Tr4V3rs4L\_w1tH\_CONNECT}

Diberikan source code [main.go](http://main.go) sebagai berikut:

```go
package main


import (
    "embed"
    "encoding/json"
    "io"
    "math/rand"
    "net/http"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
    "sync"
    "time"
)


//go:embed public/*
var webFS embed.FS


var quotes = []string{
    "Pixels are silent storytellers.",
    "Every bug has a backdoor.",
    "Hacking is not about breaking things, it’s about making things do what you want",
}

type entry struct {
    Name string `json:"name"`
    Msg  string `json:"msg"`
}


type guestbook struct {
    sync.Mutex
    posts []entry
}


var book = &guestbook{posts: make([]entry, 0, 64)}


func apiQuote(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
    io.WriteString(w, quotes[rand.Intn(len(quotes))])
}


func apiClock(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
    io.WriteString(w, time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339))
}


func apiGuestbook(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    switch r.Method {
    case http.MethodGet:
        book.Lock()
        defer book.Unlock()
        json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(book.posts)
    case http.MethodPost:
        var e entry
        if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&e); err != nil {
            http.Error(w, "", http.StatusBadRequest)
            return
        }
        book.Lock()
        book.posts = append(book.posts, e)
        book.Unlock()
        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
    default:
        http.Error(w, "", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
    }
}
func banner(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
    http.ServeFile(w, nil, "../docs/banner.png")
}


func staticHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    rawPath := r.URL.EscapedPath() // ← keeps %2e%2e%2f intact


    if rawPath == "/" {
        data, _ := webFS.ReadFile("public/index.html")
        w.Write(data)
        return
    }


        p := "." + rawPath
        if _, err := os.Stat(p); err != nil {
            io.WriteString(w, "Resource not found.")
            return
        }


    f, err := os.Open(p)
    if err != nil {
        http.NotFound(w, r)
        return
    }
    defer f.Close()


    fi, err := f.Stat()
    if err != nil {
        http.NotFound(w, r)
        return
    }


    http.ServeContent(w, r, filepath.Base(p), fi.ModTime(), f)
}

func main() {
    rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())


    mux := http.NewServeMux()
    mux.HandleFunc("/banner.png", banner)
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/quote", apiQuote)
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/clock", apiClock)
    mux.HandleFunc("/api/guestbook", apiGuestbook)
    fileServer := http.FileServer(http.FS(webFS))
    mux.Handle("/static/", http.StripPrefix("/static/", fileServer))
    mux.HandleFunc("/", staticHandler)


    http.ListenAndServe(":80", mux)
}
```

Aplikasi ini tampak rentan terhadap LFI karena staticHandler membuka path dari user menggunakan os.Open() tanpa validasi yang memadai. Namun, jika menggunakan path traversal seperti /../../, permintaan akan diredirect oleh http.ServeMux. Sementara itu, jika menggunakan encode seperti %2e%2e/, path tidak dikenali sebagai valid oleh sistem file sehingga tetap gagal.

Setelah research menggunakan keyword “Go path traversal CTF writeup”, ditemukan resource berikut [https://ctftime.org/writeup/33608](https://ctftime.org/writeup/33608).  
![][image2]

Dari temuan ini, diketahui bahwa Golang mendukung metode CONNECT. Karena lokasi flag belum diketahui, percobaan awal dilakukan dengan mencoba mengakses /etc/passwd untuk konfirmasi. Hasilnya, file /etc/passwd berhasil dibuka, menandakan bahwa terdapat LFI.

![][image3]

Setelah menelusuri file yang dapat dibaca, ditemukan /docs/text pada about.html, seperti berikut.

![][image4]

Dari petunjuk tersebut, digunakan metode yang sama seperti saat menampilkan /etc/passwd untuk mengakses /docs/text. Hasilnya, flag berhasil ditemukan di file tersebut.

## Web - Web V2

Diberikan source code [main.py](http://main.py) dan nginx.conf sebagai berikut:

`main.py`:
```py
from flask import Flask, request, render_template, redirect, session, abort
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import requests
import secrets
import bcrypt


app = Flask(__name__)
app.secret_key = secrets.token_hex(64)
app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///ctf.db'
db = SQLAlchemy(app)


class User(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = db.Column(db.String(50), unique=True, nullable=False)
    password = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False)
    is_admin = db.Column(db.String(1), default='0')


with app.app_context():
    db.create_all()


def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    salt = bcrypt.gensalt()
    return bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode('utf-8'), salt).decode('utf-8')


def check_password(stored_password: str, provided_password: str) -> bool:
    return bcrypt.checkpw(provided_password.encode('utf-8'), stored_password.encode('utf-8'))


@app.route('/')
def index():
    if 'user_id' not in session:
        return redirect('/login')


    user = db.session.get(User, session['user_id'])
    if user.is_admin == '1':
        return render_template('index.html', admin=True, username=user.username)
    else:
        return render_template('index.html', admin=False, username=user.username)


@app.route('/admin/fetch', methods=['GET', 'POST'])
def admin_fetch():
    if 'user_id' not in session:
        return redirect('/login')


    user = db.session.get(User, session['user_id'])
    if user.is_admin != '1':
        return "You are not authorized.", 403


    result = None
    if request.method == 'POST':
        data = request.get_json()
        url = data.get('url')


        parsed_url = urlparse(url)


        if parsed_url.hostname != 'daffainfo.com':
            result = "Error: Only URLs with hostname 'daffainfo.com' are allowed."
        else:
            try:
                resp = requests.get(url, timeout=5)
                result = resp.text
            except Exception as e:
                result = f"Error fetching URL: {str(e)}"


    return render_template('fetch.html', result=result)


@app.route('/register', methods=['GET', 'POST'])
def register():
    if request.method == 'POST':
        data = request.get_json()
        data['password'] = hash_password(data['password'])


        user = User(**data)
        db.session.add(user)
        db.session.commit()


        return redirect('/login')
    return render_template('register.html')


@app.route('/login', methods=['GET', 'POST'])
def login():
    if request.method == 'POST':
        data = request.get_json()
        username = data['username']
        password = data['password']
        user = db.session.execute(
            db.select(User).filter_by(username=username)
        ).scalar_one_or_none()


        if user and check_password(user.password, password):
            session['user_id'] = user.id
            return redirect('/')
        else:
            return "Invalid credentials."
    return render_template('login.html')


@app.route('/internal')
def internal():
    if request.remote_addr != '127.0.0.1':
        abort(403)
    return "Flag: IFEST13{fake_flag}"


if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=False, host="0.0.0.0", port=1337)
```

`nginx.conf`:
```
events {}


http {
    server {
        listen 80;


        location = /admin/fetch {
            deny all;
        }


        location = /admin/fetch/ {
            deny all;
        }


        location = /internal {
            deny all;
        }


        location = /internal/ {
            deny all;
        }


        location / {
            proxy_pass http://ctfapp:1337;
            proxy_http_version 1.1;
            proxy_set_header Host $host;
            proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        }
    }
}

`register.py`

import requests


BASE_URL = "http://103.163.139.198:54321"


def create_admin_user():
    register_data = {
        "username": "chiikawa",
        "password": "malware",
        "is_admin": "1",
    }


    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }

```

Dengan kredensial pada solver di atas, login dilakukan sebagai admin. Selanjutnya, dilakukan bypass Nginx ACL dengan pathname manipulation. Karena versi Nginx yang digunakan adalah 1.22.0, ditambahkan karakter hex \`85\` setelah \`/admin/fetch\` untuk melewati pembatasan akses. Referensi: [https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/pentesting-web/proxy-waf-protections-bypass.html\#bypass-nginx-acl-rules-with-pathname-manipulation](https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/pentesting-web/proxy-waf-protections-bypass.html#bypass-nginx-acl-rules-with-pathname-manipulation)

IFEST13{ah\_there\_it\_is,\_we\_did\_it\_brian,\_we\_solve\_spectre,\_high\_five\!\_a9x7e2kd}

Diberikan sebuah file `.pyc`, untuk mengekstrak isinya, kami gunakan [https://github.com/zrax/pycdc](https://github.com/zrax/pycdc), di sini terlihat ada file besar hasil dekompilasi

Terlihat bahwa program mengambil sebuah *input* flag, kemudian dilakukan operasi penambahan atau pengurangan dengan tiap elemen 1 dari list todo, berdasarkan elemen 0-nya, nanti *input* akan dibandingkan dengan “result” sedemikian rupa menjadi list “target” yang nanti di-zip dengan res. 

```
        for r, t in zip(res, [ # ...trunc ]):
```

Maka dari itu, untuk mendapatkan *flag* bisa kita kembalikan operasi tersebut, dari list “target”. Dengan menggunakan Claude, kami mendapatkan *solver* sebagai berikut:

```py
import re
import ast


def find_bracket_match(text, start_pos):
    """Find the closing bracket for an opening bracket at start_pos."""
    count = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(text[start_pos:], start=start_pos):
        if ch == '[':
            count += 1
        elif ch == ']':
            count -= 1
            if count == 0:
                return i + 1
    raise ValueError("Closing bracket not found")


def extract_todo_literal(text):
    """Extract the todo array literal from the text."""
    # Find 'todo = [][['
    match = re.search(r'todo\s*=\s*\[\]\[\[', text)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError("todo assignment not found")
   
    # Find literal start position
    offset = match.group().find('[[')
    literal_start = match.start() + offset
   
    # Find matching closing bracket
    literal_end = find_bracket_match(text, literal_start)
   
    literal = text[literal_start:literal_end]
    assert literal.startswith('[[') and literal.endswith(']]')
   
    return literal, match.start()


def extract_target_literal(text):
    """Extract the target array literal from the text."""
    # Find 'for r, t in zip(res,'
    match = re.search(r'for\s+r\s*,\s*t\s+in\s+zip\s*\(\s*res\s*,', text)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError("zip(res, target) not found")
   
    # Find opening bracket after match
    start = text.find('[', match.end())
    if start == -1:
        raise ValueError("Opening bracket for target not found")
   
    # Find matching closing bracket
    end = find_bracket_match(text, start)
   
    return text[start:end]
def parse_todo_blocks(text, todo_start_pos):
    """Parse todo array into list of coordinate pairs."""
    # Find section containing todo definition
    user_pos = text.find('userinput =', todo_start_pos)
    todo_section = text[todo_start_pos:user_pos]
   
    # Pattern to match blocks of coordinate pairs
    pattern = re.compile(r'\[\[\s*((?:\(\s*\d+,\s*\d+\s*\)\s*,?\s*)+)\]\]', re.DOTALL)
    blocks = pattern.findall(todo_section)
   
    # Parse blocks into list of lists
    todo_list = []
    for block in blocks:
        # Wrap in brackets and evaluate
        parsed_block = ast.literal_eval('[' + block + ']')
        todo_list.append(parsed_block)
   
    return todo_list


def compute_flag(todo_list, target_list):
    """Compute the flag from todo operations and target values."""
    flag_chars = []
   
    for items, target in zip(todo_list, target_list):
        # Calculate net value based on position (even indices add, odd subtract)
        net = sum(d if idx % 2 == 0 else -d for idx, d in items)
       
        # Compute character from target and net
        char_code = (target - net) % 256
        flag_chars.append(chr(char_code))
   
    return ''.join(flag_chars)


def main():
    # Read the file
    with open('wunvhw.py', 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
        text = f.read()
    # Extract literals
    todo_literal, todo_start = extract_todo_literal(text)
    target_literal = extract_target_literal(text)
   
    # Parse arrays
    todo = ast.literal_eval(todo_literal)
    target = ast.literal_eval(target_literal)
   
    print(f"Todo length: {len(todo)}")
    print(f"Target length: {len(target)}")
   
    # Parse todo into structured format
    todo_list = parse_todo_blocks(text, todo_start)
   
    # Compute and print flag
    flag = compute_flag(todo_list, target)
    print(f"Flag: {flag}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

# Cryptography - Kujou
IFEST13{https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hX\_3P0TBGP4\&flag=28c24126cb289846}

Diberikan sebuah [chall.py](http://chall.py), dimana setelah dibaca itu merupakan Mersenne twister, general-purpose pseudorandom number generator. Dimana kita bisa mencari exploitnya.

```py
from pwn import *

# Define the mask bits and leak mask
mask_bits = [0, 7, 11, 18, 22, 25, 29]
leak_mask = 0x22440881

def solve():
    # Connect to the server
    conn = remote('103.163.139.198', 8049)

    # Send the leak mask
    conn.sendlineafter(b"Enter leak mask: ", hex(leak_mask).encode())

    for _ in range(50):
        # Receive the leak line
        leak_line = conn.recvline().decode().strip()
        if not leak_line.startswith("Your leak:"):
            continue  # Skip any unexpected lines

        # Extract the leak value
        leak = int(leak_line.split(": ")[1])

        # Compute the bit to send
        bit = 0
        for b in mask_bits:
            bit ^= (leak >> b) & 1

        # Send the bit
        conn.sendlineafter(b"Just gimme one bit: ", str(bit).encode())

    # Print all remaining output (should contain the flag)
    print(conn.recvall().decode())

    # Close the connection
    conn.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

```
